model.name: HOKA Clifton 10 - Women's
model.description:
'

Lighter and more cushioned than ever before, the Hoka Clifton 10 empowers runners like you to log miles no matter the challenge. Constructed with a jacquard knit upper, these shoes offer superior breathability and comfort with every step. The smooth MetaRocker and CMEVA midsole provide a stable, springy ride with an improved forefoot fit. Plus, the rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame ensures an enhanced underfoot transition and supports every step. Effortlessly blend style and performance with the Hoka Clifton 10.

Hoka Clifton 10 features:

  • Double-lace lock ensures a secure fit.
  • Molded EVA sockliner adds maximum comfort.
  • Reflective upper details enable low-light visibility.
  • Durable abrasion rubber outsole offers superior traction.
  • Weight: 8 oz.

Long walks, daily miles, and busy days on your feet feel easier when comfort leads the way. The HOKA Clifton 10 balances lightweight cushioning with a smooth, stable ride, pairing a breathable jacquard knit upper with CMEVA cushioning, MetaRocker geometry, and a rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame for fluid transitions and dependable support.

  • Jacquard knit upper for breathable comfort
  • Double-lace lock helps create a secure fit
  • Molded EVA sockliner adds soft underfoot comfort
  • Reflective upper details enhance low-light visibility
  • Durable abrasion rubber outsole for reliable traction
  • Weight: 8 oz.

Size & Fit Guidance

Reviews point to a secure, close-to-foot feel. For the best fit, we recommend your usual size if you like a snug, locked-in hold through the midfoot.

Best For

Best for walking, long shifts, everyday training, and anyone who wants plush comfort throughout the day.

Cushioning & Road Feel

This ride leans soft, smooth, and protective rather than firm and ground-close. Wearers consistently call out the cushioning as a standout, while the MetaRocker shape helps keep transitions feeling easy and efficient.

Break-In & Durability

Many wearers find the Clifton 10 comfortable right away, making it an easy choice for regular rotation. The supportive platform and abrasion rubber outsole are built to handle repeated daily wear.

"

sizeChart.sizeChartTipTx:
Unfortunately, there is no international sizing standard. Sizes vary from country to country. Please use the tables above only as a guide to help you in ordering the correct size. Please note that all sizes, are listed and sold in US sizes., |

Women's shoes are made on a narrower last (the foot-shaped form used in making shoes) than men's. In addition, the heel on a woman's shoe is narrower than the forefoot width. Men's shoes have the same width at the forefoot and heel. The medium width for women's shoes is B, while the medium width for men's shoes is D.

Women can wear men's shoes by converting their size to men's by subtracting 1.5 from their numeric size. For example, if you are a size 8 in women's, you would try a 6.5 in men's sizes. This is a loose conversion and doesn't change the difference in width and forefoot-to-heel ratios.

, | If you still have questions about fit or sizing please contact Customer Service., | If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the smaller size for a tighter fit or the larger size for a looser fit.
